section.intro: Edit projects with other people in real time. Projects sync through a collaboration server that you or your group runs, and that server decides who can join.

empty.title: No servers yet
empty.description: Ask the person who runs your group's server for its address, then add it here.

server.signedOutHint: This computer isn't signed in to this server.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeConfirm.description: Oleafly signs out of this server and forgets it. Projects already on this computer stay where they are.

devices.title: Your devices
devices.description: Computers signed in to this server with your account. Sign out any you no longer use.

signOutConfirm.title: Sign out {{name}}?
signOutConfirm.description: That computer stops syncing with this server until someone signs in on it again.

reachable.label: Address
reachable.fail: Oleafly couldn't reach this address. Check the address and your network.

https.label: Secure connection
https.pass: The connection is encrypted and the certificate is valid.
https.fail: The server's certificate isn't valid, or the address doesn't use https.
https.info: This is a test server on this computer, so it runs without https.
https.skipped: Not checked because the address didn't answer.

protocol.label: Version
protocol.pass: This version of Oleafly works with the server.
protocol.fail: Oleafly and the server need different versions. One of them needs an update.
protocol.info: The server is newer than this version of Oleafly but still works with it.
protocol.skipped: Not checked because an earlier check failed.

webSocket.label: Live connection
webSocket.fail: Something between you and the server blocks live edits. A firewall or proxy may need a change.
webSocket.info: Live edits get through, but the connection took a while.
webSocket.skipped: Not checked because an earlier check failed.

signInProviders.label: Sign-in options
signInProviders.pass: The server has at least one way to sign in.
signInProviders.fail: The server has no way to sign in yet. Ask its admin.
signInProviders.info: The server has a way to sign in, but some options are turned off.
signInProviders.skipped: Not checked because an earlier check failed.

email.label: Email
email.fail: The server's email settings don't work.
email.info: Email isn't set up on this server. People are added without an email.
email.skipped: Not checked because an earlier check failed.

clock.label: Clock
clock.pass: Your clock and the server's clock agree.
clock.fail: Your clock and the server's clock are far apart. Check the date and time on this computer.
clock.info: Your clock is a little off from the server's.
clock.skipped: Not checked because an earlier check failed.

addServer.title: Add a collaboration server
addServer.description: Enter the address your group gave you. Oleafly checks the server before you sign in.
addServer.setupDescription: Nobody has signed in here yet. Enter the setup code from the server's log. Whoever signs in first with the code becomes the server's admin.
addServer.signInDescription: Your browser opens so you can sign in there. Oleafly never sees your password.
addServer.noProviders: This server has no way to sign in yet. Ask its admin to set one up.
addServer.waitingDescription: Finish signing in in the browser window that opened, then come back here.

errors.unreachable: Oleafly couldn't reach the server. Check the address and your connection, then try again.
errors.not_https: This address doesn't use a secure connection. Collaboration servers need an address that starts with https.
errors.client_too_old: This server needs a newer version of Oleafly. Update Oleafly, then try again.
errors.server_too_old: This server needs an update before it works with this version of Oleafly. Ask its admin.
errors.not_admitted: You're not on this server's list yet. Ask its admin to add you.
errors.sign_in_timed_out: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
errors.unauthorized: You're signed out of this server. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your role on this server doesn't allow that.
errors.not_found: The server couldn't find that. It may already be gone.
errors.conflict: That clashes with a change someone else made. Reload and try again.
errors.rate_limited: The server is busy. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.setup_code_invalid: That setup code doesn't match. Check the server's log for the right code.
errors.server: The server ran into a problem. Try again later, or ask its admin.
errors.internal: Something went wrong in Oleafly. Try again.
errors.server_changed: This address now belongs to a different server, so Oleafly didn't send it anything. If you trust the new server, remove this one and add it again.
errors.duplicate_server: This server is already in your list under another address. If it moved, remove the old entry first, then add it again.
errors.device_in_use: Someone else already signed in to this server from this computer account. Each person needs their own account on the computer to sign in.

admin.title: Manage {{name}}
admin.loadFailed: Oleafly couldn't load this from the server.

members.description: Everyone who has signed in to this server.
members.devicesDescription: Sign out a device that is lost or no longer used.
members.lastAdmin: This server needs at least one admin. Make someone else an admin first.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{name}} from this server?
removeConfirm.description: Their devices are signed out right away. Projects they own stay on the server, and you can add them back later.

deviceSignOutConfirm.title: Sign out {{name}}?
deviceSignOutConfirm.description: That device stops syncing with this server until its owner signs in on it again.

allowlist.description: People on this list can sign in to the server with the role you pick.
allowlist.empty: Nobody is on the list yet.
allowlist.duplicate: That person is already on the list.

domains.description: Anyone with a verified email address at these domains can sign in with the role you pick.
domains.duplicate: That domain already has a rule.

settings.description: These settings apply to everyone on this server.
settings.adminOnly: Only admins can change these settings.

guestsEnabled.label: Allow guests
guestsEnabled.description: Members can invite people from outside the server to projects they own.

guestApprovalRequired.label: Approve guests first
guestApprovalRequired.description: A maintainer or admin approves each guest invitation before it works.

directoryVisible.label: Member directory
directoryVisible.description: Members can look each other up by name when they share a project.

directoryShowsEmail.label: Show email addresses in the directory
directoryShowsEmail.description: Members see each other's email addresses when they look someone up.

linkSharingAllowed.label: Allow link sharing
linkSharingAllowed.description: Project owners can let any member open a project from its link.

accessLogsAllowed.label: Allow project access logs
accessLogsAllowed.description: Project owners can keep a log of who opened their project.

emailNotifications.label: Email notifications
emailNotifications.description: The server emails people when they're added or when someone shares a project with them.

log.description: Sign-ins, device changes and admin actions on this server.

kinds.refreshReuseDetected: Reused an old sign-in, so the device was signed out
kinds.allowlistAdded: Added someone to the allowed list
kinds.allowlistRemoved: Removed someone from the allowed list
